dedupe_keys.name: u surf a global 1km spatially continuous urban surface property dataset for kilometer scale urban resolving earth system modeling

description: The U-Surf collaboration led by the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign publishes global urban-surface parameters for kilometre-scale climate modelling. The circa-2020, 1 km product describes roof, wall and canyon radiative properties, building height, urban fractions and thermal properties. It also provides building-temperature and air-conditioning parameters with CESM-compatible surface files. Zenodo distributes NetCDF and GeoTIFF packages under CC-BY-SA-4.0, publicly and free with attribution and share-alike conditions. Version 1.1 fills some Asian gaps and changes aggregation of selected parameters to facet-area weighting. A limitation is that mapped and assumed parameter values represent grid-cell urban surfaces, not surveyed construction details for each building. The fields can initialise urban canopy simulations and explore heat or cooling-energy responses. U-Surf complements categorical Local Climate Zone maps with continuous physical parameters and prepared model inputs. Format compatibility and simulation performance were not tested.
